certified_by: CTO mode, Round 92 (per CEO Round 91 directive: freeze L3 as immutable certification artifact)
immutability: This certificate is IMMUTABLE. Once created, it must not be modified. Any future L3 re-validation must create a new certificate with a new version (L3-CERTIFICATE-B005-v2, etc.). This is per Article IX (certification is observational) and Article VI (never manufacture provenance).
certificate_purpose: Proves that FEBio and SfePy independently solve the same compressible neo-Hookean hyperelastic benchmark (L3-BENCHMARK-005) and agree with an independently-derived analytical reference to within 0.005% at all 11 loading-path points. This validates the simulation substrate for neo-Hookean hyperelasticity ONLY — not for viscoelasticity, damage, contact, FSI, fracture, or any other physics.

validated: Compressible neo-Hookean hyperelasticity (split formulation: W = (μ/2)(Ī₁-3) + (K/2)(ln J)²)
Uniaxial z-tension on unit cube, 0-10% strain
Cauchy stress extraction via push-forward from 2nd PK stress
11-point loading-path verification with frozen quantitative metrics
NOT_validated: Thrombus material behavior (blood clot is NOT neo-Hookean)
Any geometry other than 1-element unit cube
Any element type other than hex8
scope_of_validation.scope_principle: Per CEO Round 91: 'Do not infer: neo-Hookean validated → thrombus fracture validated. That would repeat the exact category error the machine has spent 10+ rounds eliminating.'
